reading.title: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LANTERN BAY CONCERNING PAYMENTS IN LIEU OF TAXES FOR THE BEACON POINT APARTMENTS

candidates.quote: WHEREAS, the owner has asked the City to accept an annual payment in lieu of taxes;
candidates.wording: asked the City to accept an annual payment in lieu of taxes
candidates.value: annual payment in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: Section 1. The City Council approves a payment in lieu of taxes for Beacon Point for a period of 15 years.
candidates.wording: approves a payment in lieu of taxes
candidates.value: payment in lieu of taxes for 15 years

candidates.quote: (a) 16 of the 80 homes are reserved as affordable homes;
(b) each affordable home is leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of area median income;
candidates.wording: income at or below 60 percent of area median income
candidates.value: at or below 60% of area median income

candidates.quote: (c) rents do not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year;
candidates.wording: rents do not exceed the 60 percent rent limit

candidates.quote: (d) the requirements last for 30 years from the date the first affordable home is leased;
candidates.value: 30 years from the date the first affordable home is leased

candidates.quote: (e) the owner and any later owner of the property are responsible for meeting the requirements;
candidates.wording: owner and any later owner of the property are responsible

candidates.quote: (f) the owner files an annual compliance certificate with the City by March 1 of each year; and
candidates.value: annual compliance certificate by March 1 each year

candidates.quote: (g) the owner repays all abated taxes with interest if a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice.
candidates.wording: repays all abated taxes with interest
candidates.value: repay all abated taxes with interest if default not cured within 60 days
